Before editing, read `AGENTS.md`, `README.md`, `docs/RESOURCE_MAP.md`, and `docs/PAPER_STYLE_GUIDE.md`. For a self-contained handoff, read `docs/AI_HANDOFF_PROMPT.md`. Run `python scripts/workflow.py start <module-key>` for the assigned module, use `config/project.json` as the machine-readable path map, and keep `work/tasks/<module-key>.md` synchronized with new work, blockers, completed items, and NEEDS_REVIEW items. Respect module ownership: only `feature/paper-shell` may change global typography/layout. Never create a second full-paper TeX tree, hand-copy frozen results from old files, or use force push/reset-hard to resolve collaboration conflicts.
